name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. After completing his engineering degree at the University of Porto, a chance encounter with a local racing team led him to a pit lane internship. He quickly proved his worth, displaying a keen eye for detail and a knack for optimizing performance. Over the years, he climbed the ranks, from race engineer to team coordinator, honing his leadership and technical skills along the way. 

As Head of Operations for CLRT by Almeras, Ricardo focuses on streamlining processes and ensuring every department works in sync. He believes in empowering his team, encouraging open communication, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Ricardo is known for his analytical approach, often spending hours poring over data to identify marginal gains that can make a difference on the track. His methodical nature is complemented by a genuine passion for motorsport, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height, with a focused expression that reflects his analytical mind.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even on race days.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Portuguese coffee being brewed in the garage every morning.
